mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.image AS productImage, p.brand, p.model, p.price, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.stock, p.status AS productStatus, c.quantity, (p.price * c.quantity) AS subtotal, c.create_time AS createTime FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, product_id AS productId, quantity, create_time AS createTime FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
